title_seed: 讓不知道成為一級輸出
central_problem: 30 天之後，ResearchForge 真正解決的是生成文字，還是控制材料到主張之間的可信邊界？
reader_takeaway: 可靠研究 infrastructure 不只產生答案，也能指出第一個證據缺口、保留 UNKNOWN 並停止不合法的輸出。

V6A controlled materialization matrix passed 18/18, but the live canary was unavailable and no current qualifying artifact was bound。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: observed current worktree separates canonical admission, legal materialization, format/identity checks, provenance and execution budget; later implementation remains uncommitted。
